dog.description_text: Gramps is currently in foster care and ready for adoption via our virtual process! Gramps, an 11-year-old male, just arrived and is still getting settled in, so we’re just beginning to learn who they are. Right now, everything is new—new people, new sounds, new routines—and we’re giving them time to relax, decompress, and show us their true personality at their own pace. Here’s what we know so far about his time in foster care: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1YyFKcs64yx8pZlva6LArSPR4tN6Z94T9/view?usp=drive_link His foster says "Gramps is one of the most affectionate felines you’ll ever meet! He lives for pets and churu, and he’ll keep you company on the sofa while you work and relax. He also loves to greet friends with trills, chirps, and purring. He settled right into a new place from the start. He loves affection and lives for pets." He is a lap cat. He is neutered, vaccinated, microchipped, and has had preventative treatments to ensure he is ready for his next steps. Submit an adoption survey from above and our team will reach out via phone or email (check spam) to schedule a counseling call. Please remember, pets cannot be held or reserved.
